entries.surface: the `X-openwop-*` webhook delivery header family (Webhook-Id, Event-Type, Timestamp, Signature, Signature-Algorithm)
entries.authority: RFC 0165 §C.1: hosts SHOULD dual-emit the `OpenWOP-*` family with identical values; subscribers SHOULD accept either; the `X-openwop-*` family MUST still be sent through v1.x and is removed at 2.0
entries.note: The un-prefixed `{hex}` signature value was corrected in place (INTEROP-MATRIX 2026-08-24), not deprecated. The SDKs' `openwop-Webhook-Signature: v1=` header appears in no spec file and is an SDK-versus-spec defect fixed in openwop-sdks alongside RFC 0165 (helpers verify OpenWOP-Signature, then X-openwop-Signature, then the legacy name).

entries.surface: `409 interrupt_already_resolved` (interrupt.md) and `410 interrupt_gone` (interrupt-profiles.md) for an invalidated interrupt token
entries.authority: v2 charter program C.4 (error registry): one code per condition
entries.replacement: one registered code for "token invalidated", chosen by the C.4 child RFC
entries.note: Not a deprecation today: both codes are live and normative in different documents for overlapping conditions (a token invalidated by resolution or cancel). Recorded here so the overlap is not lost before the error registry decides it.

entries.surface: `engineVersion` typed integer at the discovery root and string on run-event / run-snapshot / three event payloads
entries.authority: RFC 0165 §A.4 (recorded; unification is a v2 C.5 item — changing either type is a COMPATIBILITY §2.2 break in v1.x)
entries.note: In v1.x the per-event value is the decimal string rendering of the root integer (version-negotiation.md §"Protocol version grammar").

entries.authority: v2 charter C.4 (RFC 0167 §E; version-negotiation.md names `lastSequence` authoritative and `since` back-compat for pre-v1.0 deployments)
entries.replacement: `lastSequence` in v1.x; the v2 C.4 child defines the cursor (RFC 0165 G7)
entries.note: Proposed: the prose tolerates `since` without an RFC or annotation, so there is nothing to cite as a v1.x deprecation; the v2 cut removes it with the cursor redefinition.

entries.authority: v2 charter C.4 (RFC 0167 §E): `OpenWOP-*` for every non-standard header; RFC 0165 §C.1 covered only the webhook family

entries.surface: the 11 `§host.*` families RFC 0144 classed `extension` (brand, canvas, chat, coordination, dataIntegration, entities, kanban, knowledge, launchStudio, messaging, webResearch) — declared in neither the dotted nor the root spelling

entries.surface: the `/v1/` path-key prefix on every versioned operation
entries.authority: RFC 0172 §A.2 (v2 operations are unversioned path keys on a bare origin; v1 keys retained through the overlap and removed with the v1 tree at Phase 5)
entries.note: Proposed: the prefix is the v1 wire surface itself and cannot be deprecated inside v1.x; the row exists so the removal has a date and the alias coverage gate sees the surface.
